scored_by: scripts/rubric.mjs with gemini-4-hydrogen, run by the primary; two passes per asset (A on the exact 8x nearest-neighbour upscale, B on the engine debug sheet), baseline for the publishable gate

verdict.note: Baseline for the binding publishable gate (mean >= 3.5, no criterion below 3). Seven v2 assets scored with the unchanged rubric, two faithful views, and one instrument: scripts/rubric.mjs with gemini-4-hydrogen for all 14 passes. No fallback was needed. Recorded mean 3.25 with 22 below-floor criterion scores, so the publishable gate is not met. Prior records are preserved byte-for-byte in test/art/scores-before-intent.json (mean 3.69, gemini-3.5-flash-lite) and test/art/scores-agent-vision.json (mean 3.39, agent-vision). No score was revised upward and no below-floor finding was removed. The 4.0 exceptional tier remains documented as unreachable in docs/rubric.md and is not the gate here.

silhouette.why: The bottle shoulders, neck, and cap read clearly as a potion at 1x, though the wide brimmed stopper slightly resembles a top hat.

value_separation.why: The light mint glass, medium-dark red liquid, and very dark brown stopper occupy distinct value levels that separate cleanly.

lighting.why: All three regions are completely flat fills with no highlights or shadows to establish a light direction or three-dimensional form.

edge_language.why: Edges are clean and noise-free, but the silhouette and internal material transitions share the exact same raw, unoutlined treatment.

cluster_discipline.why: The sprite consists solely of three large, contiguous color blocks with zero single-pixel confetti.

palette_craft.why: The mint, crimson, and brown hues suit the subject coherently, but there are no value ramps or hue-shifted shading at all.

passes.subject: potion

silhouette.why: The symmetrical flask shape with a rounded body, narrow neck, and stopper reads clearly at 1x without colour, though the wide flat cork slightly resembles a hat.

value_separation.why: The pale glass, dark brew, and darker cork separate cleanly from one another in value, even though each part has no internal tonal variation.

lighting.why: There is no lighting or shading anywhere on the sprite, leaving every surface completely flat with no implied volume or light direction.

edge_language.why: Edges are clean and consistent without pixel noise, but the lineless flat colour blocks treat silhouette and interior material boundaries identically.

cluster_discipline.why: Each material forms a single clean, contiguous cluster with zero stray pixels or broken confetti.

palette_craft.why: The mint, burgundy, and brown hues suit a potion bottle, but each material uses only a single flat colour with no value or hue ramps.

tiebreak.reason: The two passes disagree by two points. The image is flat local colour with no directional cue, which is better than contradictory light (anchor 1) but short of one consistent direction (anchor 3).

value_separation.why: All adjacent parts—the pale blade, olive guard, dark center block, brown grip, and bright yellow pommel—have distinct luminance steps that separate cleanly.

lighting.why: Every material is filled with completely flat color, providing neither a consistent light direction nor any highlight and shadow modeling to define the form.

edge_language.why: The lineless silhouette edges are clean and consistent, but interior material transitions use the same flat hard cuts without distinct detail-edge treatment.

cluster_discipline.why: Each component consists of solid, contiguous pixel blocks with zero orphan pixels or stray noise.

passes.subject: sword

silhouette.why: The 1x black silhouette in panel C unmistakably reads as a sword with clear blade, crossguard, grip, and pommel proportions.

value_separation.why: All adjacent parts separate cleanly in value, though each part consists of a single flat tone with no internal value separation.

lighting.why: There is no directional lighting or shading on any part, leaving the entire sword completely flat with no lit or shadowed form.

edge_language.why: Edges are clean and free of noise, but the sprite uses uniform hard borders with no distinct treatment for silhouette, material, or detail edges.

cluster_discipline.why: Every part is built from solid, contiguous, easily readable pixel clusters with no stray single-pixel confetti.

palette_craft.why: The base hues loosely suit steel, leather, and brass, but there are no color ramps at all and the olive guard clashes with the bright yellow pommel.

silhouette.why: The plumed helmet, broad shoulders, hanging arms, and vertical sword make the figure clearly readable as an armed humanoid at 1x, though the merged blocky legs reduce lower-body clarity.

value_separation.why: Major regions like the light armor and dark tunic separate well, but the dark teal limbs and deep navy torso shadows sit very close in value to the black outline.

lighting.why: Top-left illumination is consistently established across the torso, arms, plume, and crossguard, though the helmet face and sword blade remain mostly flat.

edge_language.why: A heavy black outline consistently frames the outer silhouette and separates limbs, though internal material edges are minimal and the right tip of the crossguard ends in a solid black block.

cluster_discipline.why: All shading and colour regions are built from clean, deliberate multi-pixel blocks and bands with no stray single-pixel noise.

palette_craft.why: Cool steel greys, deep indigo-blues, dark teal, and muted gold pair harmoniously with cool shadows, though some ramps like the tunic highlight jump sharply in saturation while the blade is unshaded.

passes.subject: humanoid

value_separation.why: Major armor and tunic regions separate, but the dark navy torso shadow, dark teal limbs, and dark red plume sit within one value step of the black outline.

lighting.why: Top-left lighting shapes the torso and crossguard, yet the bright band at the bottom of the helmet and flatly shaded limbs contradict that direction.

edge_language.why: A consistent black outline defines the figure cleanly, but internal part boundaries use the exact same heavy line treatment as the outer silhouette.

cluster_discipline.why: Clusters are clean and free of stray single-pixel noise, with only the 1px-wide sword blade, hilt, and forearms forced thin by the small scale.

palette_craft.why: Cool slate and blue tones keep the palette mostly coherent, but several ramps are flat or step unevenly alongside pure black outlines and muddy olive gold.

tiebreak.reason: The two passes disagree by two points. The helmet, torso, legs and separate sword read as an armed figure in the silhouette panel but the limbs are blocky and partly merge with the body.
The helmet gradient and blade highlight share an upper-left direction; the torso is flat, so one mass is shaded against it.

silhouette.why: The knight is recognizable at 1x without color thanks to the helmet crest, shield, and sword, though the torso and limbs form a stiff, boxy silhouette.

value_separation.why: Major elements like the dark shield, green tunic, and red plume separate cleanly, though the helmet, armored limbs, and sword blade share very similar light-grey values.

lighting.why: The tunic, shield, and sword follow a consistent top-left light source, but the helmet, legs, boots, and plume are shaded flatly with uniform borders instead of directional form.

edge_language.why: Edge treatment shifts inconsistently between uniform bright rectangular borders on the armor and boots, an unoutlined tunic, and noisy single-pixel artifacts along the shield rim.

cluster_discipline.why: Most masses use clean, readable rectangular clusters, though stray single-pixel spikes on the shield edge and sword tip disrupt the perimeter.

palette_craft.why: The colors suit a knightly subject, but several ramps step unevenly from flat midtones to harsh near-black shadows without cohesive warm-to-cool hue shifting.

passes.subject: character

value_separation.why: Most major parts separate at 1x, but the helmet, arms, legs, and sword blade share closely clustered blue-grey values that reduce contrast where they meet.

lighting.why: Light generally comes from the top-left on the torso, arms, and shield, but the sword blade is highlighted along its opposite right edge while the plume and boots are shaded symmetrically.

edge_language.why: Border treatments shift inconsistently across parts—combining bright outlines on the plume and boots, a bright bottom strip under the shadowed torso, unoutlined legs, and stray dark edge pixels—without a unified hierarchy.

cluster_discipline.why: Core body masses are built from solid, readable pixel blocks, but minor single-pixel protrusions and orphan dark pixels appear around the shield rim and upper arm.

palette_craft.why: The subject-appropriate colours are coherent overall, yet the ramps step unevenly with an abrupt value jump across the torso, flat two-tone boots, and a washed-out salmon outline on the plume.

passes.subject: prop

silhouette.why: The lantern's hanging ring, domed cap, framed body, and flared base form an immediately recognizable silhouette at 1x without any color information.

value_separation.why: All structural parts separate clearly in value at 1x, though the brass cap and base are mostly flat single-value fills with minimal internal tonal range.

lighting.why: The brass cap and base lack directional form shading, while the diagonal banding on the flame and inconsistent pillar shading fail to establish a unified light source.

edge_language.why: The sprite uses a consistent outer silhouette outline and distinct internal edges around the glass frame and lineless flame.

cluster_discipline.why: Most regions are built from clean, readable clusters at 1x, with only a few single-pixel accents along the edges of the flame and cap.

palette_craft.why: The warm brass and flame hues contrast well against the cool blue-grey frame and dark glass, but the brass ramp is overly flat and shares its brightest yellow directly with the flame.

silhouette.why: The covered well, support posts, cylindrical stone base, hanging bucket, and oval ground platform read immediately at 1x without colour.

value_separation.why: Major structural masses separate clearly by value, though the dark post bases sit very close in value to the dark ground shadow and the brick mortar lines are subtle.

lighting.why: Most elements suggest top-left illumination with a rightward ground shadow, but the water gradient brightens toward the back interior and the bucket lacks directional shading.

edge_language.why: Edge treatment shifts inconsistently between the lineless roof with light fringe pixels, the dark-outlined posts and bucket, and the jagged ground edges with stray bottom pixels.

cluster_discipline.why: Large colour blocks on the roof, stone wall, and shadow hold together cleanly, but small noisy pebbles, stray base pixels, and thin horizontal ground lines break cluster discipline.

palette_craft.why: Hues suit a wooden and stone well, though the greenish-yellow rope clashes slightly with the warm roof and the shading ramps step unevenly in saturation and value.

passes.subject: scene

silhouette.why: The triangular roof, twin posts, central cylinder, and circular base read clearly as a covered well at 1x without colour.

value_separation.why: Major components separate cleanly across the sprite, though the left and right roof halves and the inner beam sit very close in value.

lighting.why: The large ground shadow implies strong light from the upper-left, yet the roof is shaded symmetrically top-to-bottom and the well wall and posts lack a consistent lit side.

edge_language.why: Edge treatments conflict across parts, mixing a bright halo outline on the bucket, jagged high-contrast pixels on the well rim, and unoutlined raw edges on the roof and base.

cluster_discipline.why: Primary masses use clean broad clusters, while scattered small pixel pebbles along the base edge and stray rim highlights fall below typical minimum cluster sizes.

palette_craft.why: Subject hues are plausible and coherent overall, but the roof and stone ramps step somewhat evenly without strong temperature shifts and the ground shadow is overly flat.
